sources.line_clock_authority: CD169 Cruise Report Appendix D: Swath Survey Data List

attribution.scope: processed XYZ soundings within 1000m of frozen CAND003 only
attribution.candidate_lines: only line numbers encoded by that product filename
attribution.rule: assign each sounding to the line whose 1-minute ship-track polyline has the smallest horizontal distance to the sounding coordinate
attribution.ambiguity: do not discard ambiguous points; report nearest distance, second-nearest distance and gap. Attribution is inferred geometry, not raw ping provenance.

line_specific_comparison.geometry_thinning: one attributed 2005 sounding per candidate-centered 100m square cell, selected nearest cell center without depth
line_specific_comparison.2008_depth_estimator: median good-beam depth within 100m of retained 2005 coordinate
line_specific_comparison.line_temporal_reproduction: a line passes only if it passes against BOTH independent 2008 lineages
